## 1. Verdict

Same length as parent. The mutation targets the TEXT payload with an invalid-UTF-8 byte, probing the parser's encoding-degradation path (srt::encoding's windows-1252/lossy fallback — 0xF3 maps to `ó` in cp1252) rather than the timing path probed by flip2_048 — the two assigned flip fixtures cover both hostile surfaces, and offset 136 is the last stride-8 flip that still lands in the file (parent is 144 B). Consumed by `committed_corpus_survives` (survival invariants: damage cap, valid intervals, cues ≤ bytes) — ran green this session, so the invalid byte demonstrably does not panic the encoding layer or corrupt the surviving cues' intervals.
